statement: Hasta's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Moon; its presiding deity is Savitar (a solar deity of skill and inspiration), symbolized by a hand. It is traditionally associated with dexterity, precision, and the ability to turn intention into skilled action — a hands-on capacity to build, refine, and heal.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
